question: Among never-served world edges that first loop by cycle 60 and remain absent from the readout structure through cycle f + 39, does loop retention in the first 20 cycles predict a sustained first structure entry in cycles f + 40 through 120, after controlling for retention in the adjacent 20-cycle window and for early rank, count, strength and follow-up horizon?

reference.status: CONFIRMED, TEMPORALLY AMBIGUOUS; not a temporal-order result
reference.why_this_block: The prior block's assertion_cycle was the first structure appearance after the landmark. That admits a re-entry by an edge already present before the landmark and labels it a new assertion. The reverse model also used a post-landmark rate whose denominator was the follow-up control. This block requires a structure-free interval through f + 39, makes the event a two-cycle entry at f + 40 or later, and measures both early and proximal retention before the outcome window. No seed, row or part from the prior block is reused.

design.world: generate_compositional_world(seed=, cycles=120) with the PHASE_ACQUISITION schedule and one replay per seed
design.population: never-served world edges with ever_loop=true, formation_cycle <= 60, no structure appearance at any cycle <= formation_cycle + 39, and full early and proximal windows
design.excluded: never-served edges that never loop; edges forming after cycle 60; edges with any structure appearance through f + 39; edges served at least once; edges with incomplete predictor windows
design.structure_free_interval: no structure appearance at any cycle from formation_cycle through formation_cycle + 39, inclusive
design.outcome: sustained first structure entry: the first cycle t >= formation_cycle + 40 with appearances at both t and t + 1; entry_cycle = t. Final presence at cycle 120 is descriptive only.
design.outcome_horizon: formation_cycle + 40 through 120; f <= 60 leaves at least 21 outcome cycles; followup_cycles/120 is the single horizon control
design.freshness: New seed block 20620101-20620124. The collision scan over docs JSON is empty at freeze time. No prior block's seed, row or part is reused.

primary_predictors.early_retention: distinct loop cycles in formation_cycle..formation_cycle+19 divided by 20
primary_predictors.proximal_retention: distinct loop cycles in formation_cycle+20..formation_cycle+39 divided by 20
primary_predictors.rank20: minimum 1-based position in the repaired observer's full pre-cap universe over formation_cycle..formation_cycle+19
primary_predictors.count20: direct temporal transition count at formation_cycle + 19
primary_predictors.strength20: maximum loop_candidate strength over reported loops in formation_cycle..formation_cycle+19
primary_predictors.followup: outcome cycles from formation_cycle + 40 through 120, divided by 120; the single fitted horizon control

sensitivity_predictors.count40: direct temporal transition count at formation_cycle + 39
sensitivity_predictors.final_assertion: presence in the structure at cycle 120; descriptive secondary outcome, never the primary event

design.late_cohort_note: No late-formation subgroup. Edges with formation_cycle > 60 are outside this block's scope because the structure-free interval would leave too few outcome cycles.

model.primary_formula: logit P(sustained entry) = b0 + b_early*z(early_retention) + b_proximal*z(proximal_retention) + b_rank*z(log2(rank20)) + b_count*z(count20) + b_strength*z(strength20) + b_followup*z(followup) + seed fixed effects
model.seed: twenty-four-level fixed effect, first seed as reference
model.proximal_role: pre-outcome control. It is measured in f+20..f+39, before the outcome window begins at f+40; it is not a reverse-time variable and is not defined after the event.
sensitivity_models: full model adding rank40, count40 and strength40
final-presence model with final_assertion as outcome
model.sensitivity_status: reported but not used for the verdict; they cannot rescue a failed primary criterion

inference.primary: Firth Wald 95% interval for the early-retention odds ratio per 1 SD in the joint model. This is the single primary criterion.
inference.proximal: The proximal-retention coefficient is reported as the separation control. It determines whether the early window is distinguishable from the adjacent pre-outcome window.
inference.multiplicity: one primary coefficient; the base, full and final-presence models are sensitivity diagnostics, not additional tests
inference.no_causal_claim: Observational entry-transition model. A positive early coefficient narrows the timing question; it does not identify a mechanism or a causal effect.

criteria.name: proximal separation
criteria.test: proximal-retention OR <= 1 or its 95% CI includes 1

verdicts.CONFIRMED: P1-P4 pass: early retention adds a positive association with the later entry transition beyond proximal retention and the controls.
verdicts.CONFIRMED, PROXIMALLY AMBIGUOUS: P1-P3 pass but P4 fails: both windows carry positive associations; the block does not identify the early window as the relevant one.
verdicts.DIRECTIONAL ONLY: P1 and P3 pass but P2 fails: the point estimate is positive, the interval is not.
verdicts.VOID: A gate fails; no coefficient is read.

gates.D1_population: at least 60 eligible edges and 20 sustained entries; one row per seed-edge
gates.D2_structure_free: every eligible edge has no structure appearance at any cycle <= f + 39, has finite early and proximal retention in full 20-cycle windows, and has f <= 60
gates.D3_rank_coverage: at least 95% of eligible edges have a finite rank20
gates.D4_seed_levels: all 24 planned seeds contribute eligible rows
gates.D5_convergence: the primary joint fit and the base fit converge with finite coefficients
gates.D6_complete: every fitted row has finite count20, strength20 and followup
gates.D7_entry_validity: every entry has a finite entry_cycle > f + 39 with appearances at entry_cycle and entry_cycle + 1; every non-entry has entry_cycle = None; no edge has a structure appearance before f + 40
gates.D8_no_collision: the seed block is collision-free at freeze and check
gates.D9_separation: abs(Pearson r(early_retention, proximal_retention)) <= 0.80; otherwise the two windows are not separable and the block is VOID
gates.D10_exposure: every eligible edge has at least 20 cycles in f + 40..120; f <= 60 already implies at least 21

sample_size.power_calculation: none. The structure-free 40-cycle requirement may leave too few entries; D1 is the only feasibility check and is applied once. The thresholds are not lowered after the count is seen.

authorisation.note: No grant is recorded. This module freezes the design only; it must not run a cell.

runner.note: Runner built behind the grant check. --dry-run prints the 24 commands without a database; --cell, --measure and --finish refuse until a complete dated grant is recorded. No grant, cell or result exists.

not_evidence: A preregistration, not a result. It spends no seed and makes no capability, causal, retention or general engine claim. The prior block's ambiguous result is not evidence for this design; the structure-free interval, the two-cycle entry and the 24-seed block are design choices, and a different interval or entry rule is a different block.
